spec.description: Kingspan AIR-CELL Retroshield is a fibre-free, high-performance thermo-reflective insulation and vapour barrier comprising an encapsulated 7mm air cell core faced on both sides with reflective aluminium foil[][][]. Engineered to combat heat gain and loss via radiation, convection, and conduction, it features an anti-tear surface that provides superior strength during retrofit and new build applications[][]. It is non-allergenic, non-irritant, and CodeMark certified for NCC compliance across residential and commercial buildings[][][].
features: Suitable for new build and refurbishment projects[
spec.fire: Flammability Index 3 (Low) to AS 1530.2; Group 1 to AS/NZS 3837; early fire hazard indices 0/0/0/0-1 to AS 1530.3[][
spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4859.1:2002 Amdt 1, AS/NZS 4200.1, CodeMark Certified CM20001 for BCA/NCC compliance[][][][
spec.sustainability: Fibre-free, zero ODP, non-allergenic, clean to install without itchy fibres[][
install: Allow recommended sag between framing members (approx. 40mm) to create reflective air spaces[
Tape all longitudinal and end joins with 72mm wide Kingspan reinforced aluminium foil tape[
Firmly squeegee or roll tape to ensure permanent pressure-sensitive adhesion[
Maintain minimum 50mm clearance around heat-producing flues and recessed light fittings[
If span between framing exceeds 2.4m, install safety mesh support prior to laying insulation[][

problem_keywords: expensive cooling bills in metal buildings
use_cases: retrofitting under commercial warehouse metal roofs to reflect summer radiant heat
insulating domestic garages and steel sheds against temperature extremes and dripping condensation
lining precast tilt-up concrete walls to enhance thermal comfort in commercial tenancies

retrieval.rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Retroshield is a 7mm thick, fibre-free thermo-reflective insulation blanket comprising an encapsulated air cell core sandwiched between two highly reflective aluminium foil facings. Designed for roofs, ceilings, walls, and sheds in both new build and retrofit scenarios, it delivers an R0.14 material R-value, an Extra Heavy Duty rating, and a Flammability Index of 3 to AS 1530.2. By blocking radiant heat, convective currents, and air leakage, it dramatically moderates internal temperatures and controls roof condensation in metal-clad and industrial buildings.
